title: Post and Manage Reviews from Members Perspective
text:
## Post and Manage Reviews from Members Perspective
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000002342

## Posting Reviews
On the member profile page click the " Write a Review " button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616716/original/eMsvdvRrg0XG8U21G-NSqSrzYLBY1KkDrw.jpeg?1687995562 | alt: ]
After clicking Write a Review , visitors will be prompted to complete the review form. Within the Review form the users will be able to fill out:
The Title of the Review
The full Review
The member's rating
Name or Company
Email Address
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616717/original/VjtIx2S1ZHfm0sS1TND6rZQfHKjirDbAYA.jpeg?1687995575 | alt: ]
If the user leaving a review is an existing member that is currently logged in, the name and email will automatically populate and cannot be edited:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616722/original/qcgoOgjWHLg1mX8cIZKNq-5JBcRXPFkhkg.png?1687995584 | alt: ]

## How To Accept / Delete Reviews as a Member
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616745/original/8efHog8v59g4ds-kLbumDNbsYF4hjWvvFQ.jpeg?1687995594 | alt: ]
Now the member can either Accept or Delete the review:

## Delete
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616747/original/23NNcB4cviapU9PkfghIv1usmaSMoO2mLw.jpeg?1687995608 | alt: ]

## Accept
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616749/original/M9Emi_JPBurTxRPLwAY4N1fgxpjiXCmtlw.png?1687995615 | alt: ]
If it is accepted, it will show the " Accepted " label with the option to delete later right below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616751/original/OQbbF6QB7Eq7p6gaVbATG5BQTVdgfL2RXA.jpeg?1687995623 | alt: ]

## Accepting Reviews on Mobile
On mobile, larger tables require users to slide left and right to view all the columns. Members can also rotate their phone to see the " View More " button.

## Requesting More Review
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616766/original/2O79XFXUlNSTyHPT5a7JWNaQFs_ScnCYOQ.jpeg?1687995649 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616796/original/uVRlZCKFPYDmdDFrIe98vooNSjJwgL6cBw.jpeg?1687995667 | alt: ]
This link can be shared through email, text and social media:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616801/original/her6b96-P7Zbc5Tz_7Gswkb_AcNeODDPKw.png?1687995699 | alt: ]

## Request More Reviews Button
Two advanced settings need to be enabled for the request More Reviews button to display:
promote_feature
promote_feature_reviews
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144600705/original/Bye9-8OkZci5gz5bLsfhmiQBMbnCangbOA.png?1718048970 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144600836/original/hSV9K4dPdHVtkTguvzTKsBxgVNVQGUgfNA.png?1718049071 | alt: ]

## Reply To Member Review
The member can use the Reply to Member Review feature to respond to the review.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181773006/original/q81ULIeoCu4Brx_D1gXj3w54uSn84rL-ng.png?1783613316 | alt: ]
